spiritgiven.comments: A couple of contact fouls that were talked about during the game from both sides. Great game, great communication.

We had a lot of productive conversations, but a couple interactions from Colombia not wanting to talk or discuss the situation. Overall great game and OK communication between captains.
Overall we were able to correct throughout the game

Great game from spirit and communication. India was supper receptive to our feedback and although they spent too much time in between points at the beginning, they adjusted accordingly. Same on our side from their feedback.
A bit of physical contact from both teams in the first half, but we all adjusted properly for the second.
We had a few calls from NZ with feedback from their team and Vz was not able to adapt our game to to match the feedback. Overall a spirited game, but we had a tough time changing and adapting.

USA had a very spirited approach to the game. We did call a couple of rough plays. Overall great game, but a couple of our players spoke out about the level of physicality and communication dismissals from one or two of their players. No concerns from us, but something to consider in future games.
Great spirited game from Australia. Discussions were short and resolved without any issues.
Both teams were able to avoid any dangerous plays. At the time of discussing calls, GB players were respectful and listened to our players. Most spirited game we played so far.
Great game from Canada. They displayed a high level of spirit and adjusted properly to avoid potential dangerous plays and contacts.

Great spirited game. The communication improved significantly since our previous game. We really appreciate the US team taking the time to discuss our feedback and showing an improvement. Not only that but the discussion in the spirit circle was great.
It was a close but very spirited game. Both teams resolved calls quickly and avoided contact. Communication was constant with the other team
Great spirit from Germany. Very spirited game. Minimal fouls and calls were retracted when needed from both teams

spiritreceived.comments: We left there was body contact that could’ve been avoided.

Unfortunately, the level of contact was too much and was continuous throughout the game despite multiple approaches to the spirit captain to correct the issue. It gave a consistent unfair advantage to Venezuela and showed either a disregard for spirit or an inability to control one's body on the field. Rules knowledge was below average and although the team was receptive to learning the rules, there were repeated violations and infractions of the same rules.
